name: push-check
title: Push Check
description: See what would go out on the next push: outgoing and incoming commits vs origin/main, files grouped by folder, which Cloudflare workers would rebuild, and an AI summary of each side.
author: jesse_gilbert

commands.name: push-check
commands.title: Push Check
commands.description: Review outgoing and incoming changes for a repo and its worktrees

preferences.name: repoPath
preferences.title: Repository
preferences.description: Main checkout of the repo to review. Its git worktrees are discovered automatically and appear in the dropdown.

preferences.name: baseRef
preferences.title: Base ref
preferences.description: What a push or merge would land on. Outgoing = commits on the worktree's branch that this ref lacks; incoming = the reverse.

preferences.name: fetchOnOpen
preferences.title: Refresh
preferences.label: Run git fetch when the command opens
preferences.description: Fetches the remote in the background so ahead/behind counts are current. Turn off if you are often offline.

preferences.name: editorCli
preferences.title: Editor CLI
preferences.description: VS Code compatible CLI used by Open File and Open Diff. Cursor's lives inside Cursor.app; VS Code's is usually /usr/local/bin/code.

preferences.name: autoDeployWorkers
preferences.title: Auto-deploying workers
preferences.description: Comma-separated Cloudflare workers whose Workers Builds deploy from main. Other apps with a wrangler config count as manual deploys. The Convex backend always counts (CI deploys it on push to main).
preferences.default: kairos-forms, gcp-apply, spar-website, kairos-website, pathfinder-website, spar-dashboard, spar-eval-tools, ingest-proxy

preferences.name: aiProvider
preferences.title: AI summaries
preferences.description: Who summarizes the outgoing and incoming diffs.

preferences.name: autoSummarize
preferences.label: Summarize automatically when the command opens
preferences.description: Summaries are cached per commit range, so reopening the command does not re-run the model.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: OpenRouter model id (anthropic/claude-opus-5 by default; anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 is about 5x cheaper). With the Anthropic provider the anthropic/ prefix is dropped and dots become dashes.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API key
preferences.description: OpenRouter or Anthropic key. Leave empty to read OPENROUTER_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the env file below.

preferences.name: apiKeyEnvFile
preferences.title: API key env file
preferences.description: Dotenv file to read the key from when the API key field is empty.

preferences.name: maxDiffChars
preferences.title: Max diff characters sent to the model
preferences.description: Diffs longer than this are truncated before summarizing (lockfiles and binaries are always skipped).
